item.title: Drone Strike on Russia's Nizhnekamsk Kills Nine People at Hostel - Authorities
item.summary: KAZAN, Russia (Sputnik) - A hostel was hit by a UAV in Russia's Nizhnekamsk, where 9 of the 13 victims of the terrorist attack on the city were killed, the office of Tatarstan head Rustam Minnikhanov said on Monday.
